Traditional automatic metrics for machine translation (MT), such as BLEU, score MT output by comparing it to one or more reference translations.
Reference-free evaluation is widely used for many NLP tasks such as grammatical error correction , dialog ) and text generation .

We evaluate reference-free metric scores on data from the WMT19 metrics task, consisting of outputs from different MT systems for 18 language pairs. For each language pair, we compute a metric score for each system, then use correlation with the provided human scores to assess the quality of our metric.
